run_benchmark_env_reset: run the benchmark script to measure environment reset time in milliseconds
run_benchmark_rendering_fps: run the benchmark script to measure rendering FPS for a gym environment
run_benchmark_agent_view_fps: run the benchmark script to measure agent view FPS with RGB wrappers
run_benchmark_custom_env: run the benchmark script with a custom env name using the --env-name flag
run_benchmark_custom_iterations: run the benchmark script with custom reset and frame counts via --num_resets and --num_frames
